title: 为短篇拆文增加Pro PDF导出
user_summary: 短篇拆文现在可直接导出真实PDF，并与全书、单章共享同一套Pro授权和错误提示。
technical_summary: Add a stored-reading-scoped short-form PDF endpoint that validates book ownership and delegates to the shared advanced_export-gated Chromium renderer. Add separate HTML and Pro PDF controls, busy state, truthful entitlement and renderer errors, and a PDF filename derived from the work title.

短篇 PDF 与全书、单章 PDF 共享 advanced_export 授权门
